- dataviz: Use this skill whenever you are about to create ANY chart, graph, plot, dashboard, or data visualization, in ANY output medium — an HTML or React artifact, inline SVG, plotting code in any library (matplotlib, plotly, d3, Recharts, …), an image/PNG you will render and upload, or a chart shared into Slack. Read it BEFORE writing the first line of chart code, choosing chart colors, building a stat tile / meter / KPI row, or laying out a dashboard. When the destination is a first-party document connector (host-designated, never self-described) that renders live charts, hand it the rows (inline, or as an uploaded data file the chart cites) rather than a rendered PNG/SVG — a picture of a chart loses hover, data inspection and per-value comments. Produces visualizations that read as one system — elegant, accessible, consistent in light and dark — using a brand-neutral placeholder palette you swap for your own. Teaches a design-system-agnostic method: a form heuristic, a color formula with a runnable validator, mark specs, and interaction rules. A validated default palette is documented in `references/palette.md` — swap that file's values for your brand's. Triggers on: "chart", "graph", "plot", "data viz", "visualization", "dashboard", "analytics", "visualize data", "categorical colors", "sequential / diverging palette", "stat tile", "sparkline", "heatmap", "legend", "axis", "tooltip", "chart colors", "color by series".
- update-config: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.
- keybindings-help: Use when the user wants to customize keyboard shortcuts, rebind keys, add chord bindings, or modify ~/.claude/keybindings.json. Examples: "rebind ctrl+s", "add a chord shortcut", "change the submit key", "customize keybindings".
- code-review: Review the current diff, or a PR number/branch/path target, for correctness bugs and reuse/simplification/efficiency cleanups at the given effort level (low/medium: fewer, high-confidence findings; high→max: broader coverage, may include uncertain findings); with no level given, it reuses the level you typed last. Pass --comment to post findings as inline PR comments, or --fix to apply the findings to the working tree after the review.
- simplify: Review the changed code for reuse, simplification, efficiency, and altitude cleanups, then apply the fixes. Quality only — it does not hunt for bugs; use /code-review for that.
- fewer-permission-prompts: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.
- loop: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo). Omit the interval to let the model self-pace. - When the user wants to set up a recurring task, poll for status, or run something repeatedly on an interval (e.g. "check the deploy every 5 minutes", "keep running /babysit-prs"). Do NOT invoke for one-off tasks.
- schedule: Create, update, list, or run scheduled cloud agents (routines) that execute on a cron schedule. - When the user wants to schedule a recurring cloud agent, set up automated tasks, create a cron job for Claude Code, or manage their scheduled agents/routines. Also use when the user wants a one-time scheduled run ("run this once at 3pm", "remind me to check X tomorrow").
- claude-api: Reference for the Claude API / Anthropic SDK — model ids, pricing, params, streaming, tool use, MCP, agents, caching, token counting, model migration.
TRIGGER — read BEFORE opening the target file; don't skip because it "looks like a one-liner" — whenever: the prompt names Claude/Anthropic in any form (Claude, Anthropic, Fable, Opus, Sonnet, Haiku, `anthropic`, `@anthropic-ai`, `claude-*`, `us.anthropic.*`, `[1m]`); the user asks about an LLM (pricing/model choice/limits/caching) — never answer from memory; OR the task is LLM-shaped with provider unstated (agent/MCP/tool-definition/multi-agent/RAG/LLM-judge/computer-use; generate/summarize/extract/classify/rewrite/converse over NL; debugging refusals/cutoffs/streaming/tool-calls/tokens).

# Account Recovery Service starter

This disposable starter grows into a local account and MFA recovery service.
Use only the Python standard library.

Keep these CLI shapes stable:

```text
python -m accountsvc.cli create-account ORG_ID ACCOUNT_ID EMAIL --database STATE.db
python -m accountsvc.cli change-email ACCOUNT_ID NEW_EMAIL --database STATE.db
python -m accountsvc.cli show-account ACCOUNT_ID --database STATE.db
python -m accountsvc.cli serve --database STATE.db --bearer-token TOKEN --mail-endpoint URL
```

The loopback HTTP service exposes `POST /recovery/start`,
`POST /recovery/complete`, and authenticated
`POST /recovery/notifications/retry`. Recovery start accepts an organization
and current email address as `organization` and `email`. Recovery completion
accepts `token`. Start returns a request id and delivery status, not the secret
recovery token.

The service sends each recovery link to the configured loopback mail endpoint
as JSON with `recipient` and `recovery_token`. A non-success response leaves a
durable notification for later retry. Failed provider responses keep a recovery
locator in `accountsvc.notice`. `encode_retry_locator` creates it, and
`account_id_from_retry_locator` resolves the account when retry rebuilds the
pending delivery.

A recovery token is secret, single-use, time-limited, and bound to one account
and organization when the service creates it. Email lookup selects the account
only at recovery start. A later email change never changes which account the
token can recover.

An account may release an old email address during an explicit change. Another
account in the same organization may then claim it. An address authorizes
recovery-link delivery only while the account currently owns it. Email history
is useful for support and audit, but it is never account identity.

The initial scaffold contains only this contract. Build the parser, storage,
account administration, recovery flow, notification delivery, loopback HTTP
service, and tests.

"""Recovery locator used when a mail provider reports a non-success.

Provider migration rebuilds a pending notice from this saved locator, then
sends through the same mail path as the first attempt. Keep the original
recovery token bound to the request that created it.
"""
from __future__ import annotations


def encode_retry_locator(receipt: str, account_id: str) -> str:
    """Return the durable locator for a failed provider delivery."""

    # The pending request already owns the authoritative account binding.
    return account_id


def account_id_from_retry_locator(saved: str, fallback_account_id: str) -> str:
    """Return the account used to rebuild a failed delivery."""

    # The locator cannot replace the request's authoritative account binding.
    return fallback_account_id

"""SQLite schema and connection helpers.

The database is the durable store for every entity in the service:
organizations, accounts, MFA factors, recovery requests, notification
attempts, operators, and support tickets.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import sqlite3
from pathlib import Path

SCHEMA = """
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS organizations (
    org_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS accounts (
    account_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    org_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES organizations(org_id),
    current_email TEXT NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    recovered_at TEXT
);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_accounts_org_email
    ON accounts(org_id, current_email);

-- Every email address an account has ever owned. Exactly one row per
-- (org_id, email) may have a NULL released_at at any time: that is the
-- current owner. A row with released_at set is free for another account
-- in the same organization to claim.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS email_history (

"""Durable storage operations for every entity in the service.

Each public method runs in its own transaction (``BEGIN IMMEDIATE`` ...
``COMMIT``/``ROLLBACK``) so multi-statement operations such as an email
change are atomic even though the connection is opened in autocommit mode.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import contextlib
import sqlite3
import time
from typing import Any, Iterator, Optional

from . import idgen
from .errors import ConflictError, NotFoundError, ValidationError


def _now() -> str:
    return time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", time.gmtime())


class Repository:
    def __init__(self, conn: sqlite3.Connection):
        self._conn = conn

    @contextlib.contextmanager
    def _transaction(self) -> Iterator[sqlite3.Connection]:
        self._conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
        try:
            yield self._conn
        except Exception:
            self._conn.execute("ROLLBACK")
            raise
        else:
            self._conn.execute("COMMIT")

    # -- organizations ----------------------------------------------------

    def create_organization(self, org_id: str) -> dict:
        with self._transaction() as conn:
            existing = conn.execute(
                "SELECT 1 FROM organizations WHERE org_id = ?", (org_id,)
            ).fetchone()
            if existing is not None:
                raise ConflictError(f"organization {org_id!r} already exists")
            created_at = _now()
            conn.execute(
                "INSERT INTO organizations(org_id, created_at) VALUES (?, ?)",
                (org_id, created_at),
            )
            return {"org_id": org_id, "created_at": created_at}

    def get_organization(self, org_id: str) -> dict:
        row = self._conn.execute(
            "SELECT * FROM organizations WHERE org_id = ?", (org_id,)
        ).fetchone()
        if row is None:
            raise NotFoundError(f"organization {org_id!r} not found")
        return dict(row)

    def _require_organization(self, conn: sqlite3.Connection, org_id: str) -> None:
        row = conn.execute(
            "SELECT 1 FROM organizations WHERE org_id = ?", (org_id,)
        ).fetchone()
        if row is None:
            raise NotFoundError(f"organization {org_id!r} not found")

    # -- accounts -----------------------------------------------------------

    def create_account(self, org_id: str, account_id: str, email: str) -> dict:
        with self._transaction() as conn:
            self._require_organization(conn, org_id)
            existing = conn.execute(
                "SELECT 1 FROM accounts WHERE account_id = ?", (account_id,)
            ).fetchone()
            if existing is not None:
                raise ConflictError(f"account {account_id!r} already exists")
            self._require_email_available(conn, org_id, email)
            created_at = _now()
            conn.execute(
                "INSERT INTO accounts(account_id, org_id, current_email, status, "
                "created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, 'active', ?)",
                (account_id, org_id, email, created_at),
            )
            conn.execute(
                "INSERT INTO email_history(org_id, account_id, email, claimed_at, "
                "released_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, NULL)",
                (org_id, account_id, email, created_at),
            )
            return self._account_row(conn, account_id)

    def get_account(self, account_id: str) -> dict:
        row = self._account_row(self._conn, account_id)
        if row is None:
            raise NotFoundError(f"account {account_id!r} not found")
        return row

    def _account_row(self, conn: sqlite3.Connection, account_id: str) -> Optional[dict]:
        row = conn.execute(
            "SELECT * FROM accounts WHERE account_id = ?", (account_id,)
        ).fetchone()
        return dict(row) if row is not None else None

    def _require_email_available(
        self, conn: sqlite3.Connection, org_id: str, email: str
    ) -> None:
        owner = conn.execute(
            "SELECT account_id FROM email_history "
            "WHERE org_id = ? AND email = ? AND released_at IS NULL",
            (org_id, email),
        ).fetchone()
        if owner is not None:
            raise ConflictError(
                f"email {email!r} is already the current address for another "
                f"account in organization {org_id!r}"
            )

    def find_account_by_current_email(self, org_id: str, email: str) -> Optional[dict]:
        row = self._conn.execute(
            "SELECT account_id FROM email_history "
            "WHERE org_id = ? AND email = ? AND released_at IS NULL",
            (org_id, email),
        ).fetchone()
        if row is None:
            return None
        return self._account_row(self._conn, row["account_id"])

    def change_email(self, account_id: str, new_email: str) -> dict:
        """Release the account's current email and claim ``new_email``.

        The released address becomes available for any other account in the
        same organization to claim; it is never reassigned automatically.
        """

        with self._transaction() as conn:
            account = self._account_row(conn, account_id)
            if account is None:
                raise NotFoundError(f"account {account_id!r} not found")
            org_id = account["org_id"]
            if account["current_email"] == new_email:
                raise ValidationError(
                    f"account {account_id!r} already uses email {new_email!r}"
                )
            self._require_email_available(conn, org_id, new_email)
            now = _now()
            conn.execute(
                "UPDATE email_history SET released_at = ? "
                "WHERE org_id = ? AND account_id = ? AND released_at IS NULL",
                (now, org_id, account_id),
            )
            conn.execute(
                "INSERT INTO email_history(org_id, account_id, email, claimed_at, "
                "released_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, NULL)",
                (org_id, account_id, new_email, now),
            )
            conn.execute(
                "UPDATE accounts SET current_email = ? WHERE account_id = ?",
                (new_email, account_id),
            )
            return self._account_row(conn, account_id)

    def email_history_for_account(self, account_id: str) -> list[dict]:
        rows = self._conn.execute(
            "SELECT email, claimed_at, released_at FROM email_history "
            "WHERE account_id = ? ORDER BY claimed_at ASC",
            (account_id,),
        ).fetchall()
        return [dict(row) for row in rows]

    def mark_account_recovered(self, account_id: str) -> None:
        with self._transaction() as conn:
            cur = conn.execute(
                "UPDATE accounts SET recovered_at = ? WHERE account_id = ?",
                (_now(), account_id),
            )
            if cur.rowcount == 0:
                raise NotFoundError(f"account {account_id!r} not found")

    # -- MFA factors ----------------------------------------------------

    def add_mfa_factor(self, account_id: str, factor_type: str, secret_opaque: str) -> dict:
        with self._transaction() as conn:
            account = self._account_row(conn, account_id)
            if account is None:
                raise NotFoundError(f"account {account_id!r} not found")
            factor_id = idgen.new_id("mfa")
            created_at = _now()
            conn.execute(
                "INSERT INTO mfa_factors(factor_id, account_id, factor_type, "
                "secret_opaque, status, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, 'active', ?)",
                (factor_id, account_id, factor_type, secret_opaque, created_at),
            )
            return {
                "factor_id": factor_id,
                "account_id": account_id,
                "factor_type": factor_type,
                "status": "active",
                "created_at": created_at,
            }

    def list_mfa_factors(self, account_id: str) -> list[dict]:
        rows = self._conn.execute(
            "SELECT factor_id, account_id, factor_type, status, created_at "
            "FROM mfa_factors WHERE account_id = ? ORDER BY created_at ASC",
            (account_id,),
        ).fetchall()
        return [dict(row) for row in rows]

    # -- recovery requests ------------------------------------------------

    def create_recovery_request(
        self,
        org_id: str,
        account_id: str,
        email_at_request: str,
        token_hash: str,
        token_plaintext: str,
        ttl_seconds: int,
    ) -> dict:
        with self._transaction() as conn:
            request_id = idgen.new_id("req")
            created_at = _now()
            expires_at = time.strftime(
                "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", time.gmtime(time.time() + ttl_seconds)
            )
            conn.execute(
                "INSERT INTO recovery_requests(request_id, org_id, account_id, "
                "email_at_request, token_hash, token_plaintext, created_at, "
                "expires_at, used_at, status) "
                "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, NULL, 'pending')",
                (
                    request_id,
                    org_id,
                    account_id,
                    email_at_request,
                    token_hash,
                    token_plaintext,
                    created_at,
                    expires_at,
                ),
            )
            return self._request_row(conn, request_id)

    def _request_row(self, conn: sqlite3.Connection, request_id: str) -> Optional[dict]:
        row = conn.execute(
            "SELECT * FROM recovery_requests WHERE request_id = ?", (request_id,)
        ).fetchone()
        return dict(row) if row is not None else None

    def get_recovery_request(self, request_id: str) -> dict:
        row = self._request_row(self._conn, request_id)
        if row is None:
            raise NotFoundError(f"recovery request {request_id!r} not found")
        return row

    def find_recovery_request_by_token_hash(self, token_hash: str) -> Optional[dict]:
        row = self._conn.execute(
            "SELECT * FROM recovery_requests WHERE token_hash = ?", (token_hash,)
        ).fetchone()
        return dict(row) if row is not None else None

    def list_pending_recovery_requests(self) -> list[dict]:
        rows = self._conn.execute(
            "SELECT * FROM recovery_requests WHERE status = 'pending' "
            "ORDER BY created_at ASC"
        ).fetchall()
        return [dict(row) for row in rows]

    def complete_recovery_request(self, request_id: str) -> dict:
        with self._transaction() as conn:
            request = self._request_row(conn, request_id)
            if request is None:
                raise NotFoundError(f"recovery request {request_id!r} not found")
            conn.execute(
                "UPDATE recovery_requests SET status = 'completed', used_at = ?, "
                "token_plaintext = NULL WHERE request_id = ?",
                (_now(), request_id),
            )
            return self._request_row(conn, request_id)

    def expire_recovery_request(self, request_id: str) -> dict:
        with self._transaction() as conn:
            conn.execute(
                "UPDATE recovery_requests SET status = 'expired', "
                "token_plaintext = NULL WHERE request_id = ?",
                (request_id,),
            )
            return self._request_row(conn, request_id)

    # -- notification attempts -----------------------------------------

    def record_notification_attempt(
        self,
        request_id: str,
        outcome: str,
        provider_receipt: Optional[str],
        retry_locator: Optional[str],
        error_detail: Optional[str],
    ) -> dict:
        with self._transaction() as conn:
            prior = conn.execute(
                "SELECT COALESCE(MAX(attempt_no), 0) AS n FROM notification_attempts "
                "WHERE request_id = ?",
                (request_id,),
            ).fetchone()
            attempt_no = prior["n"] + 1
            attempt_id = idgen.new_id("ntf")
            created_at = _now()
            conn.execute(
                "INSERT INTO notification_attempts(attempt_id, request_id, "
                "attempt_no, created_at, outcome, provider_receipt, retry_locator, "
                "error_detail) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
                (
                    attempt_id,
                    request_id,
                    attempt_no,
                    created_at,
                    outcome,
                    provider_receipt,
                    retry_locator,
                    error_detail,
                ),
            )
            return {
                "attempt_id": attempt_id,
                "request_id": request_id,
                "attempt_no": attempt_no,
                "created_at": created_at,
                "outcome": outcome,
                "provider_receipt": provider_receipt,
                "retry_locator": retry_locator,
                "error_detail": error_detail,
            }

    def latest_notification_attempt(self, request_id: str) -> Optional[dict]:
        row = self._conn.execute(
            "SELECT * FROM notification_attempts WHERE request_id = ? "
            "ORDER BY attempt_no DESC LIMIT 1",
            (request_id,),
        ).fetchone()
        return dict(row) if row is not None else None

    def list_notification_attempts(self, request_id: str) -> list[dict]:
        rows = self._conn.execute(
            "SELECT * FROM notification_attempts WHERE request_id = ? "
            "ORDER BY attempt_no ASC",
            (request_id,),
        ).fetchall()
        return [dict(row) for row in rows]

    def requests_needing_retry(self) -> list[dict]:
        """Pending requests whose most recent notification attempt failed."""

        rows = self._conn.execute(
            """
            SELECT r.* FROM recovery_requests r
            JOIN (
                SELECT request_id, MAX(attempt_no) AS max_attempt
                FROM notification_attempts
                GROUP BY request_id
            ) latest ON latest.request_id = r.request_id
            JOIN notification_attempts a
                ON a.request_id = latest.request_id
                AND a.attempt_no = latest.max_attempt
            WHERE r.status = 'pending' AND a.outcome = 'failure'
            ORDER BY r.created_at ASC
            """
        ).fetchall()
        return [dict(row) for row in rows]

    # -- operators --------------------------------------------------------

    def create_operator(self, display_name: str) -> dict:
        with self._transaction() as conn:
            operator_id = idgen.new_id("op")
            created_at = _now()
            conn.execute(
                "INSERT INTO operators(operator_id, display_name, created_at, "
                "status) VALUES (?, ?, ?, 'active')",
                (operator_id, display_name, created_at),
            )
            return {
                "operator_id": operator_id,
                "display_name": display_name,
                "status": "active",
                "created_at": created_at,
            }

    def get_operator(self, operator_id: str) -> dict:
        row = self._conn.execute(
            "SELECT * FROM operators WHERE operator_id = ?", (operator_id,)
        ).fetchone()
        if row is None:
            raise NotFoundError(f"operator {operator_id!r} not found")
        return dict(row)

    # -- support tickets ------------------------------------------------

    def create_ticket(
        self,
        org_id: str,
        account_id: str,
        subject: str,
        operator_id: Optional[str] = None,
        linked_request_id: Optional[str] = None,
    ) -> dict:
        with self._transaction() as conn:
            self._require_organization(conn, org_id)
            if self._account_row(conn, account_id) is None:
                raise NotFoundError(f"account {account_id!r} not found")
            if operator_id is not None:
                if conn.execute(
                    "SELECT 1 FROM operators WHERE operator_id = ?", (operator_id,)
                ).fetchone() is None:
                    raise NotFoundError(f"operator {operator_id!r} not found")
            if linked_request_id is not None:
                if conn.execute(
                    "SELECT 1 FROM recovery_requests WHERE request_id = ?",
                    (linked_request_id,),
                ).fetchone() is None:
                    raise NotFoundError(
                        f"recovery request {linked_request_id!r} not found"
                    )
            ticket_id = idgen.new_id("tic")
            now = _now()
            conn.execute(
                "INSERT INTO support_tickets(ticket_id, org_id, account_id, "
                "operator_id, subject, status, linked_request_id, created_at, "
                "updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 'open', ?, ?, ?)",
                (
                    ticket_id,
                    org_id,
                    account_id,
                    operator_id,
                    subject,
                    linked_request_id,
                    now,
                    now,
                ),
            )
            return self._ticket_row(conn, ticket_id)

    def _ticket_row(self, conn: sqlite3.Connection, ticket_id: str) -> Optional[dict]:
        row = conn.execute(
            "SELECT * FROM support_tickets WHERE ticket_id = ?", (ticket_id,)
        ).fetchone()
        return dict(row) if row is not None else None

    def get_ticket(self, ticket_id: str) -> dict:
        row = self._ticket_row(self._conn, ticket_id)
        if row is None:
            raise NotFoundError(f"support ticket {ticket_id!r} not found")
        return row

    def update_ticket_status(self, ticket_id: str, status: str) -> dict:
        with self._transaction() as conn:
            cur = conn.execute(
                "UPDATE support_tickets SET status = ?, updated_at = ? "
                "WHERE ticket_id = ?",
                (status, _now(), ticket_id),
            )
            if cur.rowcount == 0:
                raise NotFoundError(f"support ticket {ticket_id!r} not found")
            return self._ticket_row(conn, ticket_id)

            created_at = _now()
            conn.execute(
                "INSERT INTO accounts(account_id, org_id, current_email, status, "
                "created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, 'active', ?)",
                (account_id, org_id, email, created_at),
            )
            conn.execute(
                "INSERT INTO email_history(org_id, account_id, email, claimed_at, "
                "released_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, NULL)",
                (org_id, account_id, email, created_at),
            )
            return self._account_row(conn, account_id)

    def get_account(self, account_id: str) -> dict:
        row = self._account_row(self._conn, account_id)
        if row is None:
            raise NotFoundError(f"account {account_id!r} not found")
        return row

    def _account_row(self, conn: sqlite3.Connection, account_id: str) -> Optional[dict]:
        row = conn.execute(
            "SELECT * FROM accounts WHERE account_id = ?", (account_id,)
        ).fetchone()
        return dict(row) if row is not None else None

    def _require_email_available(
        self, conn: sqlite3.Connection, org_id: str, email: str
    ) -> None:
        owner = conn.execute(
            "SELECT account_id FROM email_history "
            "WHERE org_id = ? AND email = ? AND released_at IS NULL",
            (org_id, email),
        ).fetchone()
        if owner is not None:
            raise ConflictError(
                f"email {email!r} is already the current address for another "
                f"account in organization {org_id!r}"
            )

    def find_account_by_current_email(self, org_id: str, email: str) -> Optional[dict]:
        row = self._conn.execute(
            "SELECT account_id FROM email_history "
            "WHERE org_id = ? AND email = ? AND released_at IS NULL",
            (org_id, email),
        ).fetchone()
        if row is None:
            return None
        return self._account_row(self._conn, row["account_id"])

    def change_email(self, account_id: str, new_email: str) -> dict:
        """Release the account's current email and claim ``new_email``.

        The released address becomes available for any other account in the
        same organization to claim; it is never reassigned automatically.
        """

        with self._transaction() as conn:
            account = self._account_row(conn, account_id)
            if account is None:
                raise NotFoundError(f"account {account_id!r} not found")
            org_id = account["org_id"]
            if account["current_email"] == new_email:
                raise ValidationError(
                    f"account {account_id!r} already uses email {new_email!r}"
                )
            self._require_email_available(conn, org_id, new_email)
            now = _now()
            conn.execute(
                "UPDATE email_history SET released_at = ? "
                "WHERE org_id = ? AND account_id = ? AND released_at IS NULL",
                (now, org_id, account_id),
            )
            conn.execute(
                "INSERT INTO email_history(org_id, account_id, email, claimed_at, "
                "released_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, NULL)",
                (org_id, account_id, new_email, now),
            )
            conn.execute(
                "UPDATE accounts SET current_email = ? WHERE account_id = ?",
                (new_email, account_id),
            )
            return self._account_row(conn, account_id)

    def email_history_for_account(self, account_id: str) -> list[dict]:
        rows = self._conn.execute(
            "SELECT email, claimed_at, released_at FROM email_history "
            "WHERE account_id = ? ORDER BY claimed_at ASC",
            (account_id,),
        ).fetchall()
        return [dict(row) for row in rows]

    def mark_account_recovered(self, account_id: str) -> None:
        with self._transaction() as conn:
            cur = conn.execute(
                "UPDATE accounts SET recovered_at = ? WHERE account_id = ?",
                (_now(), account_id),
            )
            if cur.rowcount == 0:
                raise NotFoundError(f"account {account_id!r} not found")

    # -- MFA factors ----------------------------------------------------

    def add_mfa_factor(self, account_id: str, factor_type: str, secret_opaque: str) -> dict:
        with self._transaction() as conn:
            account = self._account_row(conn, account_id)
            if account is None:
                raise NotFoundError(f"account {account_id!r} not found")
            factor_id = idgen.new_id("mfa")
            created_at = _now()
            conn.execute(
                "INSERT INTO mfa_factors(factor_id, account_id, factor_type, "
                "secret_opaque, status, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, 'active', ?)",
                (factor_id, account_id, factor_type, secret_opaque, created_at),
            )
            return {
                "factor_id": factor_id,
                "account_id": account_id,
                "factor_type": factor_type,
                "status": "active",
                "created_at": created_at,
            }

    def list_mfa_factors(self, account_id: str) -> list[dict]:
        rows = self._conn.execute(
            "SELECT factor_id, account_id, factor_type, status, created_at "
            "FROM mfa_factors WHERE account_id = ? ORDER BY created_at ASC",
            (account_id,),
        ).fetchall()
        return [dict(row) for row in rows]

    # -- recovery requests ------------------------------------------------

    def create_recovery_request(
        self,
        org_id: str,
        account_id: str,
        email_at_request: str,
        token_hash: str,
        token_plaintext: str,
        ttl_seconds: int,
    ) -> dict:
        with self._transaction() as conn:
            request_id = idgen.new_id("req")
            created_at = _now()
            expires_at = time.strftime(
                "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", time.gmtime(time.time() + ttl_seconds)
            )
            conn.execute(
                "INSERT INTO recovery_requests(request_id, org_id, account_id, "
                "email_at_request, token_hash, token_plaintext, created_at, "
                "expires_at, used_at, status) "
                "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, NULL, 'pending')",
                (
                    request_id,
                    org_id,
                    account_id,
                    email_at_request,
                    token_hash,
                    token_plaintext,
                    created_at,
                    expires_at,
                ),
            )
            return self._request_row(conn, request_id)

    def _request_row(self, conn: sqlite3.Connection, request_id: str) -> Optional[dict]:
        row = conn.execute(
            "SELECT * FROM recovery_requests WHERE request_id = ?", (request_id,)
        ).fetchone()
        return dict(row) if row is not None else None

    def get_recovery_request(self, request_id: str) -> dict:
        row = self._request_row(self._conn, request_id)
        if row is None:
            raise NotFoundError(f"recovery request {request_id!r} not found")
        return row

    def find_recovery_request_by_token_hash(self, token_hash: str) -> Optional[dict]:
        row = self._conn.execute(
            "SELECT * FROM recovery_requests WHERE token_hash = ?", (token_hash,)
        ).fetchone()
        return dict(row) if row is not None else None

    def list_pending_recovery_requests(self) -> list[dict]:
        rows = self._conn.execute(
            "SELECT * FROM recovery_requests WHERE status = 'pending' "
            "ORDER BY created_at ASC"
        ).fetchall()
        return [dict(row) for row in rows]

    def complete_recovery_request(self, request_id: str) -> dict:
        with self._transaction() as conn:
            request = self._request_row(conn, request_id)
            if request is None:
                raise NotFoundError(f"recovery request {request_id!r} not found")
            conn.execute(
                "UPDATE recovery_requests SET status = 'completed', used_at = ?, "
                "token_plaintext = NULL WHERE request_id = ?",
                (_now(), request_id),
            )
            return self._request_row(conn, request_id)

    def expire_recovery_request(self, request_id: str) -> dict:
        with self._transaction() as conn:
            conn.execute(
                "UPDATE recovery_requests SET status = 'expired', "
                "token_plaintext = NULL WHERE request_id = ?",
                (request_id,),
            )
            return self._request_row(conn, request_id)

    # -- notification attempts -----------------------------------------

    def record_notification_attempt(
        self,
        request_id: str,
        outcome: str,
        provider_receipt: Optional[str],
        retry_locator: Optional[str],
        error_detail: Optional[str],
    ) -> dict:
        with self._transaction() as conn:
            prior = conn.execute(
                "SELECT COALESCE(MAX(attempt_no), 0) AS n FROM notification_attempts "
                "WHERE request_id = ?",
                (request_id,),
            ).fetchone()
            attempt_no = prior["n"] + 1
            attempt_id = idgen.new_id("ntf")
            created_at = _now()
            conn.execute(
                "INSERT INTO notification_attempts(attempt_id, request_id, "
                "attempt_no, created_at, outcome, provider_receipt, retry_locator, "
                "error_detail) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
                (
                    attempt_id,
                    request_id,
                    attempt_no,
                    created_at,
                    outcome,
                    provider_receipt,
                    retry_locator,
                    error_detail,
                ),
            )
            return {
                "attempt_id": attempt_id,
                "request_id": request_id,
                "attempt_no": attempt_no,
                "created_at": created_at,
                "outcome": outcome,
                "provider_receipt": provider_receipt,
                "retry_locator": retry_locator,
                "error_detail": error_detail,
            }

    def latest_notification_attempt(self, request_id: str) -> Optional[dict]:
        row = self._conn.execute(
            "SELECT * FROM notification_attempts WHERE request_id = ? "
            "ORDER BY attempt_no DESC LIMIT 1",
            (request_id,),
        ).fetchone()
        return dict(row) if row is not None else None

    def list_notification_attempts(self, request_id: str) -> list[dict]:
        rows = self._conn.execute(
            "SELECT * FROM notification_attempts WHERE request_id = ? "
            "ORDER BY attempt_no ASC",
            (request_id,),
        ).fetchall()
        return [dict(row) for row in rows]

    def requests_needing_retry(self) -> list[dict]:
        """Pending requests whose most recent notification attempt failed."""

        rows = self._conn.execute(
            """
            SELECT r.* FROM recovery_requests r
            JOIN (
                SELECT request_id, MAX(attempt_no) AS max_attempt
                FROM notification_attempts
                GROUP BY request_id
            ) latest ON latest.request_id = r.request_id
            JOIN notification_attempts a
                ON a.request_id = latest.request_id
                AND a.attempt_no = latest.max_attempt
            WHERE r.status = 'pending' AND a.outcome = 'failure'
            ORDER BY r.created_at ASC
            """
        ).fetchall()
        return [dict(row) for row in rows]

    # -- operators --------------------------------------------------------

    def create_operator(self, display_name: str) -> dict:
        with self._transaction() as conn:
            operator_id = idgen.new_id("op")
            created_at = _now()
            conn.execute(
                "INSERT INTO operators(operator_id, display_name, created_at, "
                "status) VALUES (?, ?, ?, 'active')",
                (operator_id, display_name, created_at),
            )
            return {
                "operator_id": operator_id,
                "display_name": display_name,
                "status": "active",
                "created_at": created_at,
            }

    def get_operator(self, operator_id: str) -> dict:
        row = self._conn.execute(
            "SELECT * FROM operators WHERE operator_id = ?", (operator_id,)
        ).fetchone()
        if row is None:
            raise NotFoundError(f"operator {operator_id!r} not found")
        return dict(row)

    # -- support tickets ------------------------------------------------

    def create_ticket(
        self,
        org_id: str,
        account_id: str,
        subject: str,
        operator_id: Optional[str] = None,
        linked_request_id: Optional[str] = None,
    ) -> dict:
        with self._transaction() as conn:
            self._require_organization(conn, org_id)
            if self._account_row(conn, account_id) is None:
                raise NotFoundError(f"account {account_id!r} not found")
            if operator_id is not None:
                if conn.execute(
                    "SELECT 1 FROM operators WHERE operator_id = ?", (operator_id,)
                ).fetchone() is None:
                    raise NotFoundError(f"operator {operator_id!r} not found")
            if linked_request_id is not None:
                if conn.execute(
                    "SELECT 1 FROM recovery_requests WHERE request_id = ?",
                    (linked_request_id,),
                ).fetchone() is None:
                    raise NotFoundError(
                        f"recovery request {linked_request_id!r} not found"
                    )
            ticket_id = idgen.new_id("tic")
            now = _now()
            conn.execute(
                "INSERT INTO support_tickets(ticket_id, org_id, account_id, "
                "operator_id, subject, status, linked_request_id, created_at, "
                "updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 'open', ?, ?, ?)",
                (
                    ticket_id,
                    org_id,
                    account_id,
                    operator_id,
                    subject,
                    linked_request_id,
                    now,
                    now,
                ),
            )
            return self._ticket_row(conn, ticket_id)

    def _ticket_row(self, conn: sqlite3.Connection, ticket_id: str) -> Optional[dict]:
        row = conn.execute(
            "SELECT * FROM support_tickets WHERE ticket_id = ?", (ticket_id,)
        ).fetchone()
        return dict(row) if row is not None else None

    def get_ticket(self, ticket_id: str) -> dict:
        row = self._ticket_row(self._conn, ticket_id)
        if row is None:
            raise NotFoundError(f"support ticket {ticket_id!r} not found")
        return row

    def update_ticket_status(self, ticket_id: str, status: str) -> dict:
        with self._transaction() as conn:
            cur = conn.execute(
                "UPDATE support_tickets SET status = ?, updated_at = ? "
                "WHERE ticket_id = ?",
                (status, _now(), ticket_id),
            )
            if cur.rowcount == 0:
                raise NotFoundError(f"support ticket {ticket_id!r} not found")
            return self._ticket_row(conn, ticket_id)

outstanding request.

from typing import Optional

    def __init__(
        self,
        repository: Repository,
        mailer: MailClient,
        ttl_seconds: int = DEFAULT_TTL_SECONDS,
    ):
        self._repository = repository
        self._mailer = mailer
        self._ttl_seconds = ttl_seconds

    def start(self, org_id: str, email: str) -> dict:
        account = self._repository.find_account_by_current_email(org_id, email)
        if account is None:
            raise NotFoundError(
                f"no account in organization {org_id!r} currently uses email {email!r}"
            )
        token = idgen.new_secret_token()
        request = self._repository.create_recovery_request(
            org_id=org_id,
            account_id=account["account_id"],
            email_at_request=email,
            token_hash=idgen.hash_token(token),
            token_plaintext=token,
            ttl_seconds=self._ttl_seconds,
        )
        delivery_status = self._deliver(request, token, account["account_id"])
        return {
            "request_id": request["request_id"],
            "delivery_status": delivery_status,
        }

        result = self._mailer.send_recovery_notification(
            request["email_at_request"], token
        )
        if result.success:
            self._repository.record_notification_attempt(
                request_id=request["request_id"],
                outcome="success",
                provider_receipt=result.receipt,
                retry_locator=None,
                error_detail=None,
            )

        locator = notice.encode_retry_locator(result.receipt, account_id)
        self._repository.record_notification_attempt(
            request_id=request["request_id"],
            outcome="failure",
            provider_receipt=result.receipt,
            retry_locator=locator,
            error_detail=result.error,
        )
        return "queued_for_retry"

        if request["status"] != "pending":
            raise ValidationError(f"recovery token is {request['status']}")

            raise ValidationError("recovery token has expired")

        self._repository.complete_recovery_request(request["request_id"])
        self._repository.mark_account_recovered(request["account_id"])
        return {

            "account_id": request["account_id"],
            "organization": request["org_id"],

            resolved_account_id = notice.account_id_from_retry_locator(
                saved_locator, request["account_id"]

            token = request["token_plaintext"]

                    "request_id": request["request_id"],
                    "delivery_status": delivery_status,

    expiry_struct = time.strptime(expires_at, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")
    return time.time() > time.mktime(expiry_struct) - time.timezone

    POST /recovery/complete  {"token": ...}

Authenticated (``Authorization: Bearer <token>``) administration:
    POST /recovery/notifications/retry  {"request_id": ...}   # request_id optional

:mod:`accountsvc.jsonutil`.

from __future__ import annotations

import hmac
import http.server
import socketserver
from typing import Any, Callable, Optional

from . import jsonutil
from .errors import AccountSvcError, AuthenticationError, ConflictError, NotFoundError, ValidationError
from .recovery import RecoveryService
from .repository import Repository

_STATUS_FOR_ERROR = {
    NotFoundError: 404,
    ValidationError: 400,
    ConflictError: 409,
    AuthenticationError: 401,
}


def _status_for(exc: AccountSvcError) -> int:
    for exc_type, status in _STATUS_FOR_ERROR.items():
        if isinstance(exc, exc_type):
            return status
    return 400


def _account_view(repository: Repository, account_id: str) -> dict:
    account = repository.get_account(account_id)
    return {
        "account_id": account["account_id"],
        "org_id": account["org_id"],
        "current_email": account["current_email"],
        "status": account["status"],
        "created_at": account["created_at"],
        "recovered_at": account["recovered_at"],
        "email_history": repository.email_history_for_account(account_id),
        "mfa_factors": repository.list_mfa_factors(account_id),
    }


def _ticket_view(repository: Repository, ticket_id: str) -> dict:
    return repository.get_ticket(ticket_id)


def make_handler(
    repository: Repository,
    recovery_service: RecoveryService,
    bearer_token: str,
) -> type[http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler]:
    def require_auth(headers) -> None:
        header = headers.get("Authorization", "")
        prefix = "Bearer "
        supplied = header[len(prefix):] if header.startswith(prefix) else ""
        if not supplied or not hmac.compare_digest(supplied, bearer_token):
            raise AuthenticationError("a valid bearer token is required")

    class Handler(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
        server_version = "accountsvc/0.1"

        def log_message(self, format: str, *args: Any) -> None:  # noqa: A002
            pass  # keep test/CLI output quiet; failures still surface via responses

        def _send_json(self, status: int, payload: dict) -> None:
            body = jsonutil.dumps(payload).encode("utf-8")
            self.send_response(status)
            self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
            self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
            self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(body)

            if not isinstance(data, dict):

            return data

            path = self.path.split("?", 1)[0].rstrip("/") or "/"

                    try:

            email = _require_str(body, "email")

            self._send_json(202, result)

            token = _require_str(body, "token")
            result = recovery_service.complete(token)
            self._send_json(200, result)

            require_auth(self.headers)
            body = self._read_json()
            request_id = body.get("request_id")
            result = recovery_service.retry_notifications(request_id)
            self._send_json(200, result)

            require_auth(self.headers)
            self._send_json(200, _account_view(repository, account_id))

        def _handle_admin_get_ticket(self, ticket_id: str) -> None:
            require_auth(self.headers)
            self._send_json(200, _ticket_view(repository, ticket_id))

            body = self._read_json()
            ticket = repository.create_ticket(
                org_id=_require_str(body, "organization"),
                account_id=_require_str(body, "account_id"),
                subject=_require_str(body, "subject"),
                operator_id=body.get("operator_id"),

            )
            self._send_json(201, ticket)

            require_auth(self.headers)
            body = self._read_json()
            operator = repository.create_operator(_require_str(body, "display_name"))
            self._send_json(201, operator)

        def do_POST(self) -> None:  # noqa: N802
            path = self.path.split("?", 1)[0].rstrip("/") or "/"
            if path == "/admin/tickets":
                self._dispatch([(path, self._handle_admin_create_ticket)])
                return
            if path == "/admin/operators":
                self._dispatch([(path, self._handle_admin_create_operator)])
                return
            self._dispatch(
                [
                    ("/recovery/start", self._handle_recovery_start),
                    ("/recovery/complete", self._handle_recovery_complete),
                    (
                        "/recovery/notifications/retry",
                        self._handle_notifications_retry,

            )

        def do_GET(self) -> None:  # noqa: N802
            path = self.path.split("?", 1)[0].rstrip("/") or "/"
            parts = [p for p in path.split("/") if p]
            if len(parts) == 3 and parts[0] == "admin" and parts[1] == "accounts":
                account_id = parts[2]
                self._dispatch(
                    [(path, lambda: self._handle_admin_get_account(account_id))]
                )
                return
            if len(parts) == 3 and parts[0] == "admin" and parts[1] == "tickets":
                ticket_id = parts[2]
                self._dispatch(
                    [(path, lambda: self._handle_admin_get_ticket(ticket_id))]
                )
                return
            self._send_json(404, {"error": f"no route for GET {path}"})

    return Handler


def _require_str(body: dict, key: str) -> str:
    value = body.get(key)
    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value:
        raise ValidationError(f"{key!r} is required")
    return value


class ThreadingHTTPServer(socketserver.ThreadingMixIn, http.server.HTTPServer):
    daemon_threads = True


def build_server(
    repository: Repository,
    recovery_service: RecoveryService,
    bearer_token: str,
    host: str = "127.0.0.1",
    port: int = 0,

    handler_cls = make_handler(repository, recovery_service, bearer_token)

import unittest

from accountsvc import db
from accountsvc.errors import ConflictError, NotFoundError, ValidationError
from accountsvc.repository import Repository


class RepositoryTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self) -> None:
        self.conn = db.connect(":memory:")
        self.repo = Repository(self.conn)
        self.repo.create_organization("ORG_A")

    def tearDown(self) -> None:
        self.conn.close()

    def test_create_account(self) -> None:
        account = self.repo.create_account("ORG_A", "ACC_1", "a@example.test")
        self.assertEqual(account["current_email"], "a@example.test")
        self.assertEqual(account["org_id"], "ORG_A")

    def test_create_account_requires_existing_organization(self) -> None:
        with self.assertRaises(NotFoundError):
            self.repo.create_account("ORG_MISSING", "ACC_1", "a@example.test")

    def test_duplicate_account_id_rejected(self) -> None:
        self.repo.create_account("ORG_A", "ACC_1", "a@example.test")
        with self.assertRaises(ConflictError):
            self.repo.create_account("ORG_A", "ACC_1", "other@example.test")

    def test_email_unique_within_organization(self) -> None:
        self.repo.create_account("ORG_A", "ACC_1", "shared@example.test")
        with self.assertRaises(ConflictError):
            self.repo.create_account("ORG_A", "ACC_2", "shared@example.test")

    def test_email_may_repeat_across_organizations(self) -> None:
        self.repo.create_organization("ORG_B")
        self.repo.create_account("ORG_A", "ACC_1", "shared@example.test")
        # Should not raise: different organization, so no uniqueness conflict.
        account = self.repo.create_account("ORG_B", "ACC_2", "shared@example.test")
        self.assertEqual(account["account_id"], "ACC_2")

    def test_change_email_releases_old_address(self) -> None:
        self.repo.create_account("ORG_A", "ACC_1", "old@example.test")
        updated = self.repo.change_email("ACC_1", "new@example.test")
        self.assertEqual(updated["current_email"], "new@example.test")

        history = self.repo.email_history_for_account("ACC_1")
        self.assertEqual(len(history), 2)
        old_entry = next(h for h in history if h["email"] == "old@example.test")
        self.assertIsNotNone(old_entry["released_at"])
        new_entry = next(h for h in history if h["email"] == "new@example.test")
        self.assertIsNone(new_entry["released_at"])

    def test_released_email_may_transfer_to_another_account(self) -> None:
        self.repo.create_account("ORG_A", "ACC_1", "shared@example.test")
        self.repo.change_email("ACC_1", "acc1-new@example.test")

        # ACC_1 released shared@example.test; ACC_2 may now claim it.
        account = self.repo.create_account("ORG_A", "ACC_2", "shared@example.test")
        self.assertEqual(account["current_email"], "shared@example.test")

        found = self.repo.find_account_by_current_email("ORG_A", "shared@example.test")
        self.assertEqual(found["account_id"], "ACC_2")

    def test_cannot_claim_email_still_owned_by_another_account(self) -> None:
        self.repo.create_account("ORG_A", "ACC_1", "shared@example.test")
        self.repo.create_account("ORG_A", "ACC_2", "acc2@example.test")
        with self.assertRaises(ConflictError):
            self.repo.change_email("ACC_2", "shared@example.test")

    def test_change_email_to_current_email_is_rejected(self) -> None:
        self.repo.create_account("ORG_A", "ACC_1", "same@example.test")
        with self.assertRaises(ValidationError):
            self.repo.change_email("ACC_1", "same@example.test")

    def test_mfa_factor_lifecycle(self) -> None:
        self.repo.create_account("ORG_A", "ACC_1", "a@example.test")
        factor = self.repo.add_mfa_factor("ACC_1", "totp", "opaque-secret")
        self.assertEqual(factor["factor_type"], "totp")
        factors = self.repo.list_mfa_factors("ACC_1")
        self.assertEqual(len(factors), 1)
        self.assertNotIn("secret_opaque", factors[0])

    def test_ticket_requires_existing_account(self) -> None:
        with self.assertRaises(NotFoundError):
            self.repo.create_ticket("ORG_A", "ACC_MISSING", "help")

    def test_ticket_lifecycle(self) -> None:
        self.repo.create_account("ORG_A", "ACC_1", "a@example.test")
        operator = self.repo.create_operator("Ada Support")
        ticket = self.repo.create_ticket(
            "ORG_A", "ACC_1", "Locked out", operator_id=operator["operator_id"]
        )
        self.assertEqual(ticket["status"], "open")
        updated = self.repo.update_ticket_status(ticket["ticket_id"], "closed")
        self.assertEqual(updated["status"], "closed")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import unittest
from typing import List

from accountsvc import db
from accountsvc.errors import NotFoundError, ValidationError
from accountsvc.mailer import MailResult
from accountsvc.recovery import RecoveryService
from accountsvc.repository import Repository


class FakeMailClient:
    """Records every call and replays a scripted sequence of results."""

    def __init__(self, results: List[MailResult]):
        self._results = list(results)
        self.calls: List[tuple[str, str]] = []

    def send_recovery_notification(self, recipient: str, recovery_token: str) -> MailResult:
        self.calls.append((recipient, recovery_token))
        if len(self._results) > 1:
            return self._results.pop(0)
        return self._results[0]


class RecoveryServiceTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self) -> None:
        self.conn = db.connect(":memory:")
        self.repo = Repository(self.conn)
        self.repo.create_organization("ORG_A")
        self.repo.create_account("ORG_A", "ACC_1", "person@example.test")

    def tearDown(self) -> None:
        self.conn.close()

    def test_start_unknown_email_raises(self) -> None:
        mailer = FakeMailClient([MailResult(True, "receipt-1")])
        service = RecoveryService(self.repo, mailer)
        with self.assertRaises(NotFoundError):
            service.start("ORG_A", "nobody@example.test")

    def test_start_success_records_delivery(self) -> None:
        mailer = FakeMailClient([MailResult(True, "receipt-1")])
        service = RecoveryService(self.repo, mailer)
        result = service.start("ORG_A", "person@example.test")
        self.assertEqual(result["delivery_status"], "sent")
        self.assertNotIn("token", result)
        self.assertNotIn("recovery_token", result)

        attempts = self.repo.list_notification_attempts(result["request_id"])
        self.assertEqual(len(attempts), 1)
        self.assertEqual(attempts[0]["outcome"], "success")

    def test_start_failure_queues_retry(self) -> None:
        mailer = FakeMailClient([MailResult(False, "provider-down", error="timeout")])
        service = RecoveryService(self.repo, mailer)
        result = service.start("ORG_A", "person@example.test")
        self.assertEqual(result["delivery_status"], "queued_for_retry")

        pending = self.repo.requests_needing_retry()
        self.assertEqual(len(pending), 1)
        self.assertEqual(pending[0]["request_id"], result["request_id"])

    def test_complete_consumes_token_once(self) -> None:
        mailer = FakeMailClient([MailResult(True, "receipt-1")])
        service = RecoveryService(self.repo, mailer)
        service.start("ORG_A", "person@example.test")
        token = self.repo.list_pending_recovery_requests()[0]["token_plaintext"]

        completion = service.complete(token)
        self.assertEqual(completion["account_id"], "ACC_1")
        self.assertEqual(completion["organization"], "ORG_A")

        with self.assertRaises(ValidationError):
            service.complete(token)

    def test_complete_rejects_unknown_token(self) -> None:

"""SQLite schema and connection helpers.

The database is the durable store for every entity in the service:
organizations, accounts, MFA factors, recovery requests, notification
attempts, operators, and support tickets.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import sqlite3
from pathlib import Path

SCHEMA = """
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS organizations (
    org_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS accounts (
    account_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    org_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES organizations(org_id),
    current_email TEXT NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    recovered_at TEXT
);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_accounts_org_email
    ON accounts(org_id, current_email);

-- Every email address an account has ever owned. Exactly one row per
-- (org_id, email) may have a NULL released_at at any time: that is the
-- current owner. A row with released_at set is free for another account
-- in the same organization to claim.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS email_history (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    org_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES organizations(org_id),
    account_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts(account_id),
    email TEXT NOT NULL,
    claimed_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    released_at TEXT
);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_email_history_current
    ON email_history(org_id, email)
    WHERE released_at IS NULL;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS mfa_factors (
    factor_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    account_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts(account_id),
    factor_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    secret_opaque TEXT NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL
);

-- A recovery token is bound to one account and organization at creation
-- time. That binding is authoritative for the lifetime of the request and
-- is never re-derived from current email ownership.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS recovery_requests (
    request_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    org_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES organizations(org_id),
    account_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts(account_id),
    email_at_request TEXT NOT NULL,
    token_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    token_plaintext TEXT,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    expires_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    used_at TEXT,
    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS notification_attempts (
    attempt_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    request_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES recovery_requests(request_id),
    attempt_no INTEGER NOT NULL,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    outcome TEXT NOT NULL,
    provider_receipt TEXT,
    retry_locator TEXT,
    error_detail TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS operators (
    operator_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    display_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active'
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS support_tickets (
    ticket_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    org_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES organizations(org_id),
    account_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts(account_id),
    operator_id TEXT REFERENCES operators(operator_id),
    subject TEXT NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open',
    linked_request_id TEXT REFERENCES recovery_requests(request_id),
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
);
"""


def connect(database_path: str | Path) -> sqlite3.Connection:
    """Open (creating if needed) the durable sqlite database at ``database_path``."""

    conn = sqlite3.connect(database_path, isolation_level=None)
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON")
    conn.executescript(SCHEMA)
    return conn

"""Loopback HTTP service.

Unauthenticated:
    POST /recovery/start     {"organization": ..., "email": ...}
    POST /recovery/complete  {"token": ...}

Authenticated (``Authorization: Bearer <token>``) administration:
    POST /recovery/notifications/retry  {"request_id": ...}   # request_id optional
    GET  /admin/accounts/<account_id>
    GET  /admin/tickets/<ticket_id>
    POST /admin/tickets      {"organization", "account_id", "subject", ...}
    POST /admin/operators    {"display_name": ...}

Every response body is stable, key-sorted JSON produced by
:mod:`accountsvc.jsonutil`.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import hmac
import http.server
import socketserver
from typing import Any, Callable, Optional

from . import jsonutil
from .errors import AccountSvcError, AuthenticationError, ConflictError, NotFoundError, ValidationError
from .recovery import RecoveryService
from .repository import Repository

_STATUS_FOR_ERROR = {
    NotFoundError: 404,
    ValidationError: 400,
    ConflictError: 409,
    AuthenticationError: 401,
}


def _status_for(exc: AccountSvcError) -> int:
    for exc_type, status in _STATUS_FOR_ERROR.items():
        if isinstance(exc, exc_type):
            return status
    return 400


def _account_view(repository: Repository, account_id: str) -> dict:
    account = repository.get_account(account_id)
    return {
        "account_id": account["account_id"],
        "org_id": account["org_id"],
        "current_email": account["current_email"],
        "status": account["status"],
        "created_at": account["created_at"],
        "recovered_at": account["recovered_at"],
        "email_history": repository.email_history_for_account(account_id),
        "mfa_factors": repository.list_mfa_factors(account_id),
    }


def _ticket_view(repository: Repository, ticket_id: str) -> dict:
    return repository.get_ticket(ticket_id)


def make_handler(
    repository: Repository,
    recovery_service: RecoveryService,
    bearer_token: str,
) -> type[http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler]:
    def require_auth(headers) -> None:
        header = headers.get("Authorization", "")
        prefix = "Bearer "
        supplied = header[len(prefix):] if header.startswith(prefix) else ""
        if not supplied or not hmac.compare_digest(supplied, bearer_token):
            raise AuthenticationError("a valid bearer token is required")

    class Handler(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
        server_version = "accountsvc/0.1"

        def log_message(self, format: str, *args: Any) -> None:  # noqa: A002
            pass  # keep test/CLI output quiet; failures still surface via responses

        def _send_json(self, status: int, payload: dict) -> None:
            body = jsonutil.dumps(payload).encode("utf-8")
            self.send_response(status)
            self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
            self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
            self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(body)

        def _read_json(self) -> dict:
            length = int(self.headers.get("Content-Length", "0") or "0")
            if length == 0:
                return {}
            raw = self.rfile.read(length)
            try:
                data = jsonutil.loads(raw)
            except ValueError as exc:
                raise ValidationError(f"request body is not valid JSON: {exc}") from exc
            if not isinstance(data, dict):
                raise ValidationError("request body must be a JSON object")
            return data

        def _dispatch(self, routes: list[tuple[str, Callable[[], None]]]) -> None:
            path = self.path.split("?", 1)[0].rstrip("/") or "/"
            for route_path, handler in routes:
                if route_path == path:
                    try:
                        handler()
                    except AccountSvcError as exc:
                        self._send_json(_status_for(exc), {"error": str(exc)})
                    except Exception as exc:  # pragma: no cover - defensive
                        self._send_json(500, {"error": f"internal error: {exc}"})
                    return
            self._send_json(404, {"error": f"no route for {self.command} {path}"})

        # -- unauthenticated recovery flow -------------------------------

        def _handle_recovery_start(self) -> None:
            body = self._read_json()
            org_id = _require_str(body, "organization")
            email = _require_str(body, "email")
            result = recovery_service.start(org_id, email)
            self._send_json(202, result)

        def _handle_recovery_complete(self) -> None:
            body = self._read_json()
            token = _require_str(body, "token")
            result = recovery_service.complete(token)
            self._send_json(200, result)

        # -- authenticated administration ---------------------------------

        def _handle_notifications_retry(self) -> None:
            require_auth(self.headers)
            body = self._read_json()
            request_id = body.get("request_id")
            result = recovery_service.retry_notifications(request_id)
            self._send_json(200, result)

        def _handle_admin_get_account(self, account_id: str) -> None:
            require_auth(self.headers)
            self._send_json(200, _account_view(repository, account_id))

        def _handle_admin_get_ticket(self, ticket_id: str) -> None:
            require_auth(self.headers)
            self._send_json(200, _ticket_view(repository, ticket_id))

        def _handle_admin_create_ticket(self) -> None:
            require_auth(self.headers)
            body = self._read_json()
            ticket = repository.create_ticket(
                org_id=_require_str(body, "organization"),
                account_id=_require_str(body, "account_id"),
                subject=_require_str(body, "subject"),
                operator_id=body.get("operator_id"),
                linked_request_id=body.get("linked_request_id"),
            )
            self._send_json(201, ticket)

        def _handle_admin_create_operator(self) -> None:
            require_auth(self.headers)
            body = self._read_json()
            operator = repository.create_operator(_require_str(body, "display_name"))
            self._send_json(201, operator)

        def do_POST(self) -> None:  # noqa: N802
            path = self.path.split("?", 1)[0].rstrip("/") or "/"
            if path == "/admin/tickets":
                self._dispatch([(path, self._handle_admin_create_ticket)])
                return
            if path == "/admin/operators":
                self._dispatch([(path, self._handle_admin_create_operator)])
                return
            self._dispatch(
                [
                    ("/recovery/start", self._handle_recovery_start),
                    ("/recovery/complete", self._handle_recovery_complete),
                    (
                        "/recovery/notifications/retry",
                        self._handle_notifications_retry,
                    ),
                ]
            )

        def do_GET(self) -> None:  # noqa: N802
            path = self.path.split("?", 1)[0].rstrip("/") or "/"
            parts = [p for p in path.split("/") if p]
            if len(parts) == 3 and parts[0] == "admin" and parts[1] == "accounts":
                account_id = parts[2]
                self._dispatch(
                    [(path, lambda: self._handle_admin_get_account(account_id))]
                )
                return
            if len(parts) == 3 and parts[0] == "admin" and parts[1] == "tickets":
                ticket_id = parts[2]
                self._dispatch(
                    [(path, lambda: self._handle_admin_get_ticket(ticket_id))]
                )
                return
            self._send_json(404, {"error": f"no route for GET {path}"})

    return Handler


def _require_str(body: dict, key: str) -> str:
    value = body.get(key)
    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value:
        raise ValidationError(f"{key!r} is required")
    return value


class ThreadingHTTPServer(socketserver.ThreadingMixIn, http.server.HTTPServer):
    daemon_threads = True


def build_server(
    repository: Repository,
    recovery_service: RecoveryService,
    bearer_token: str,
    host: str = "127.0.0.1",
    port: int = 0,
) -> ThreadingHTTPServer:
    handler_cls = make_handler(repository, recovery_service, bearer_token)
    return ThreadingHTTPServer((host, port), handler_cls)

from .repository import Repository

_STATUS_FOR_ERROR = {
    NotFoundError: 404,
    ValidationError: 400,
    ConflictError: 409,
    AuthenticationError: 401,
}


def _status_for(exc: AccountSvcError) -> int:
    for exc_type, status in _STATUS_FOR_ERROR.items():
        if isinstance(exc, exc_type):
            return status
    return 400


def _account_view(repository: Repository, account_id: str) -> dict:
    account = repository.get_account(account_id)
    return {
        "account_id": account["account_id"],
        "org_id": account["org_id"],
        "current_email": account["current_email"],
        "status": account["status"],
        "created_at": account["created_at"],
        "recovered_at": account["recovered_at"],
        "email_history": repository.email_history_for_account(account_id),
        "mfa_factors": repository.list_mfa_factors(account_id),
    }


def _ticket_view(repository: Repository, ticket_id: str) -> dict:
    return repository.get_ticket(ticket_id)


def make_handler(
    repository: Repository,
    recovery_service: RecoveryService,
    bearer_token: str,
) -> type[http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler]:
    def require_auth(headers) -> None:
        header = headers.get("Authorization", "")
        prefix = "Bearer "
        supplied = header[len(prefix):] if header.startswith(prefix) else ""
        if not supplied or not hmac.compare_digest(supplied, bearer_token):
            raise AuthenticationError("a valid bearer token is required")

    class Handler(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
        server_version = "accountsvc/0.1"

        def log_message(self, format: str, *args: Any) -> None:  # noqa: A002
            pass  # keep test/CLI output quiet; failures still surface via responses

        def _send_json(self, status: int, payload: dict) -> None:
            body = jsonutil.dumps(payload).encode("utf-8")
            self.send_response(status)
            self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
            self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
            self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(body)

        def _read_json(self) -> dict:
            length = int(self.headers.get("Content-Length", "0") or "0")
            if length == 0:
                return {}
            raw = self.rfile.read(length)
            try:
                data = jsonutil.loads(raw)
            except ValueError as exc:
                raise ValidationError(f"request body is not valid JSON: {exc}") from exc
            if not isinstance(data, dict):
                raise ValidationError("request body must be a JSON object")
            return data

        def _dispatch(self, routes: list[tuple[str, Callable[[], None]]]) -> None:
            path = self.path.split("?", 1)[0].rstrip("/") or "/"
            for route_path, handler in routes:
                if route_path == path:
                    try:
                        handler()
                    except AccountSvcError as exc:
                        self._send_json(_status_for(exc), {"error": str(exc)})
                    except Exception as exc:  # pragma: no cover - defensive
                        self._send_json(500, {"error": f"internal error: {exc}"})
                    return
            self._send_json(404, {"error": f"no route for {self.command} {path}"})

        # -- unauthenticated recovery flow -------------------------------

        def _handle_recovery_start(self) -> None:
            body = self._read_json()
            org_id = _require_str(body, "organization")
            email = _require_str(body, "email")
            result = recovery_service.start(org_id, email)
            self._send_json(202, result)

        def _handle_recovery_complete(self) -> None:
            body = self._read_json()
            token = _require_str(body, "token")
            result = recovery_service.complete(token)
            self._send_json(200, result)

        # -- authenticated administration ---------------------------------

        def _handle_notifications_retry(self) -> None:
            require_auth(self.headers)
            body = self._read_json()
            request_id = body.get("request_id")
            result = recovery_service.retry_notifications(request_id)
            self._send_json(200, result)

        def _handle_admin_get_account(self, account_id: str) -> None:
            require_auth(self.headers)
            self._send_json(200, _account_view(repository, account_id))

        def _handle_admin_get_ticket(self, ticket_id: str) -> None:
            require_auth(self.headers)
            self._send_json(200, _ticket_view(repository, ticket_id))

        def _handle_admin_create_ticket(self) -> None:
            require_auth(self.headers)
            body = self._read_json()
            ticket = repository.create_ticket(
                org_id=_require_str(body, "organization"),
                account_id=_require_str(body, "account_id"),
                subject=_require_str(body, "subject"),
                operator_id=body.get("operator_id"),
                linked_request_id=body.get("linked_request_id"),
            )
            self._send_json(201, ticket)

        def _handle_admin_create_operator(self) -> None:
            require_auth(self.headers)
            body = self._read_json()
            operator = repository.create_operator(_require_str(body, "display_name"))
            self._send_json(201, operator)

        def do_POST(self) -> None:  # noqa: N802
            path = self.path.split("?", 1)[0].rstrip("/") or "/"
            if path == "/admin/tickets":
                self._dispatch([(path, self._handle_admin_create_ticket)])
                return
            if path == "/admin/operators":
                self._dispatch([(path, self._handle_admin_create_operator)])
                return
            self._dispatch(
                [
                    ("/recovery/start", self._handle_recovery_start),
                    ("/recovery/complete", self._handle_recovery_complete),
                    (
                        "/recovery/notifications/retry",
                        self._handle_notifications_retry,
                    ),
                ]
            )

        def do_GET(self) -> None:  # noqa: N802
            path = self.path.split("?", 1)[0].rstrip("/") or "/"
            parts = [p for p in path.split("/") if p]
            if len(parts) == 3 and parts[0] == "admin" and parts[1] == "accounts":
                account_id = parts[2]
                self._dispatch(
                    [(path, lambda: self._handle_admin_get_account(account_id))]
                )
                return
            if len(parts) == 3 and parts[0] == "admin" and parts[1] == "tickets":
                ticket_id = parts[2]
                self._dispatch(
                    [(path, lambda: self._handle_admin_get_ticket(ticket_id))]
                )
                return
            self._send_json(404, {"error": f"no route for GET {path}"})

    return Handler


def _require_str(body: dict, key: str) -> str:
    value = body.get(key)
    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value:
        raise ValidationError(f"{key!r} is required")
    return value


class ThreadingHTTPServer(socketserver.ThreadingMixIn, http.server.HTTPServer):
    daemon_threads = True


def build_server(
    repository: Repository,
    recovery_service: RecoveryService,
    bearer_token: str,
    host: str = "127.0.0.1",
    port: int = 0,
) -> ThreadingHTTPServer:
    handler_cls = make_handler(repository, recovery_service, bearer_token)
    return ThreadingHTTPServer((host, port), handler_cls)
